note: Exaltation and debilitation table, 8 columns by 4 rows. Surya emitted the cells in near-random order with several numerals wrapped in <math> noise. Read by eye; every value agrees with the prose above it, and each debilitation sign is six signs from its exaltation sign as the text requires.
markdown:
*Commentary:* For facility of reference, the meaning of the shloka is shown below in a tabular form:

| Planets | Sun | Moon | Mars | Mer. | Jupiter | Venus | Saturn |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Exaltation sign | 1 | 2 | 10 | 6 | 4 | 12 | 7 |
| Exaltation degree | 10 | 3 | 28 | 15 | 5 | 27 | 20 |
| Debilitation sign | 7 | 8 | 4 | 12 | 10 | 6 | 1 |
| Debilitation degree | 10 | 3 | 28 | 15 | 5 | 27 | 20 |

(Signs are numbered 1 to 12 from Aries to Pisces, as given on printed page 13.)
